AutoImportContent.Name: Automatically import content
AutoImportContent.Hint: Creates world items, NPCs and journal entries extracted from the manual the first time the system is opened.

CompactSheets.Name: Compact sheets
CompactSheets.Hint: Enables a denser layout to reduce the screen space used by sheets.

CharacterPortraitMode.Name: PC · Image mode
CharacterPortraitMode.Hint: GM session control for PCs: framed portrait or exterior standee. Uses the deity background or the generic PC banner when no deity is selected.

CharacterPortraitScale.Name: PC · Exterior figure size
CharacterPortraitScale.Hint: Size percentage for the exterior PC figure.

CharacterBannerScale.Name: PC · Banner size
CharacterBannerScale.Hint: Size percentage for the PC background banner.

NpcPortraitMode.Name: NPC · Image mode
NpcPortraitMode.Hint: GM session control for NPCs: framed portrait or exterior standee with the NPC banner.

NpcPortraitScale.Name: NPC · Exterior figure size
NpcPortraitScale.Hint: Size percentage for the exterior NPC figure.

NpcBannerScale.Name: NPC · Banner size
NpcBannerScale.Hint: Size percentage for the NPC background banner.

VestCalibration.Name: Calibrate vest patch positions
VestCalibration.Hint: GM only. Allows patches to be dragged over the vest to save exact coordinates per slot.

SkillEditUnlocked.Name: Skill dice editing unlocked
SkillEditUnlocked.Hint: Local state for the wrench button on the sheet.
